_about: Reviewed exceptions to security controls. Each entry names the control, the exact text it matches, where that text appears, and why the control's purpose does not apply there. tests/test_control_exceptions.py fails on any occurrence not listed here and on any stale entry.

exceptions.control: aws-core secret-safety hook (blocks commands that fetch Secrets Manager values)
exceptions.kind: IAM permission grant in infrastructure code; not a fetch
exceptions.justification: The runtime role lets AgentCore Identity use the OAuth2 provider's vault-managed secret on the runtime's behalf to mint the agent's M2M gateway token; the runtime never reads or handles the secret value.
